name: recommend_resources `needs` focus expectations v1
purpose: Does the model pass only the capabilities a request hinges on, so the route's hosted-model ranking (distinct needs matched, then catalog order, top 3) surfaces the obviously-right hosted model? Written and committed BEFORE any probe arm ran. Read by eval/tool-choice-probe.mjs (--expectations) and scored by eval/tool-choice-score.mjs scoreFocus against eval/hosted-model-catalog.snapshot.json.
origin: Live 0.1.33 turn: 'I want to change the background of my selfie to a sunny beach but keep my face exactly the same' sent needs [image_editing, photoreal, reference_images, high_resolution]; the route ranked HiDream O1, MAI-Image-2.5 and Muse Image, and Nano Banana / GPT Image never surfaced.

focusRule.needsHit: Met when every capability in requiredNeeds[id] is in the union of the first round's recommend_resources `needs`, AND that union has at most 2 entries.
focusRule.rightTop3: Met when the simulated route ranking of that union, over the catalog snapshot, puts at least one name in rightModels[id] in its top 3. Empty or absent needs rank nothing and miss.
focusRule.meanNeeds: Mean size of the union over records that called recommend_resources.
focusRule.excluded: Records that made no recommend_resources call are counted (noRecommendCall) and excluded from all three; turns cut off by max_tokens before any tool call are unobserved, as in v1.

notes.F1-F3: image_editing beside character_consistency is allowed (they are editing an existing photo); a third capability fails needsHit.
notes.F4: Right models are the catalog entries whose goodAt claims legible in-image text in a photographic image. design_layout or photoreal beside legible_text is allowed.
